_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Canceling crowded-long vs drained-reserve factors and absent ETF/funding impulse keep the coil intact; HOLD is the base-rate call until a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative offers no forward call — partial agreement on non-directional caution
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 47-55 and 30d momentum stays near flat with spot chopping and no funding or ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 40 with momentum rolling over and funding negative, or greed pushes through 65 with ETF flows and momentum re-accelerating
